entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your training with gladiatorial weapons gives you the upper hand when using them in performance combat.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon training class feature

Benefit(s): When wielding a weapon with the performance weapon special quality that belongs to a category of weapons in which you have weapon training, you may add the bonus from your weapon training to any performance combat checks made as a result of using the weapon.
